Add separate layers before drawing tiles and labels. A layer is not a visible rectangle or text. It is an empty group that holds other nodes.

This scene is used as a cube-face texture, so it does not keep a title HUD inside the SpriteKit surface. The SwiftUI screen shows the title and status text outside the cube. The SpriteKit face keeps only puzzle tiles and coordinate labels.

Read the call order carefully: clear old nodes, create layers, calculate board metrics, then draw tiles and labels. That order keeps each render pass predictable.

in the file. They keep tile visuals and coordinate labels separate without adding extra architecture.

controls front-to-back order. A larger number appears in front of a smaller number.
